issue: A valid first-party 12 MP effort-1 stream uses 192 local histogram sets and 285120 entropy contexts. Native and Rust decoders accepted it; the repository decoder rejected the generic 65536-context limit.
fix: Only HF coefficient entropy opts into a bounded 2027520-context allowance. All other entropy streams retain the default 65536 limit. The allowance and count are checked before context-map allocation. Histogram validation and recursion limits are unchanged.
qualityEvidencePolicy: No encoder or scored raster changed. The capped matrices and original checks completed before this decoder admission fix; previously admitted maps execute the same pixel reconstruction. Full-raster replay of both measured runtime streams, a licensed real-image regression, explicit admission-boundary tests, conformance and browser checks cover the repair without repeating perceptual scoring.
